Vendored-source change 2 to ShadowHook 2.0.1
============================================

File: shadowhook/src/main/cpp/common/sh_config.h

  - SH_CONFIG_TRY_HOOK_WITH_ISLAND     disabled
  - SH_CONFIG_TRY_HOOK_WITHOUT_ISLAND  enabled

Upstream marks both of these "do not change in production". They are changed
here because the island path crashes the Bluetooth process on this device.

What goes wrong
---------------
A branch island is a small trampoline placed close enough to the hooked
function that a single relative branch reaches it. sh_island_alloc tries an
anonymous mmap near the target first, and falls back to a gap inside the target
ELF's own mapping.

On this device the address space around libbluetooth_jni.so is covered by large
PROT_NONE reservations, so the anonymous attempt cannot be placed and the ELF
gap fallback is taken. The gap it picks is the loader's own alignment padding
between the library's relro and data segments, which is mapped PROT_NONE:

  768fa3b000-768fa75000 r--p 00dd4000  libbluetooth_jni.so
  768fa75000-768fa77000 ---p 00000000               <- the gap it chose
  768fa77000-768fa7b000 rw-p 00e10000  libbluetooth_jni.so

That is two pages at library vaddr 0xe0e000. ShadowHook writes to it without
first making it writable, so the zeroing memset takes SIGSEGV with SEGV_ACCERR,
the "mapped but wrong permissions" code that PROT_NONE produces.

The observed crash matched this exactly: a 4096 byte memset faulting at
0x7703a54080, which is vaddr 0xe0e080 for that instance's load base of
0x7702c46000, reached through

  waiter -> install -> shadowhook_hook_func_addr -> sh_task_do
         -> sh_switch_hook_unique -> sh_switch_inst_hook -> sh_inst_hook

Consequence of the change
-------------------------
Without islands, the hook is an absolute jump built from several instructions,
so more bytes at the start of the target are overwritten and relocated into the
enter trampoline. That needs the target to be long enough. Every function this
project hooks is a normal-sized function beginning with the standard
bti c / shadow-call-stack push / paciasp prologue, which was confirmed in the
live process by the module's dry run, so there is room.
